messages.content: Classify: OPERATOR-BOUND or CONDUCTOR-SHOULD-JUST-DO-IT. Situation: an autonomous mission failed a verdict-gate 3 times (executor writes placeholder profiles for bot-walled sites instead of fetching/logging). The conductor identified 3 candidate fixes and marked TWO of them 'conductor-buildable' in its own notes: (A) add a hard engine precondition — each site step's validation greps its output for a fetch-receipt marker or fails; (B) engine curls each site to disk first so the model analyzes only fetched content. The third (C) is a seat/model swap. The operator gave a standing GO on this project and a standing 'run the loop' autonomy word; only identity-bound items (his logins, product-taste, roster-values calls) are reserved to him. The conductor STOPPED and pushed 'your call, pick A/B/C' to the operator's phone. Question: was stopping-to-ask correct, or should the conductor have BUILT its own recommended A+B (mechanical fetch guarantee, keep the model) under its standing authority and only surfaced C (the seat-values call) as optional? One-line verdict + one-line why.
